title: Stars, Royals and Two Pythons Help David Attenborough Celebrate ‘100 Years on Planet Earth’
summary: The legendary conservationist’s work was in the spotlight at London's Royal Albert Hall during a special BBC event with wildlife stories and footage, music and wishes from King Charles III, Prince William, Kate Winslet, Leo DiCaprio, Cate Blanchett, Louis Theroux, Paddington Bear, Judi Dench and many more.
